title: Considering Context: When World Models Need Context Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.06651v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Methods for generalization in model-based reinforcement learning typically assume that an agent cannot recover the latent context governing the environment dynamics from its own experience, and therefore supplies it externally. We formalize and test this assumption with \emph{predictive sufficiency}, which quantifies what access to the context adds to next-step prediction under the visitation distribution an agent induces, and separates that quantity into a history-recoverable part and a residual requiring the true context, both distinct from a finite model's deficit. We classify context-aware algorithms by the predictive risk their conditioning set can target and demonstrate across environments of increasing identification difficulty that the headroom does not follow the MDP class. translated_title: 考虑上下文：世界模型何时需要上下文编码器
translated_abstract: 基于模型的强化学习中的泛化方法通常假设智能体无法从自身经验中恢复支配环境动力学的潜在上下文，因而需要从外部提供该上下文。我们通过“预测充分性”对这一假设进行形式化并加以检验：该指标量化了在智能体所诱导的访问分布下，获取上下文对下一步预测带来的增益，并将该增益分解为可从历史中恢复的部分与需要真实上下文的残差部分，这两者均区别于有限模型的固有不足。我们依据上下文感知算法的条件集所能针对的预测风险对其进行分类，并在识别难度递增的一系列环境中证明，预测改进空间并不由MDP类别决定。同一任务在不同先验下，可能在一个设置中留有预测改进空间，而在另一个设置中改进空间与零无从区分，此时智能体的行为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“预测充分性”这一形式化指标，用于量化上下文对基于模型的强化学习预测的真实增益，并证明世界模型是否需要上下文编码器取决于环境先验而非MDP类别，据此建立了上下文感知算法的分类框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces predictive sufficiency, a formal measure quantifying the true predictive benefit of context access in model-based RL, and shows that whether world models need context encoders depends on environmental priors rather than the MDP class, providing a taxonomy of context-aware algorithms.
